RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 15

An all-woman panel is not evidence of anything on its own — in many ministries, HR and policy grades skew female, so such panels occur by chance. Composition proves nothing about conduct, and raising it as your main point would likely read as insinuation, damaging your standing and distracting from your real grievance.

Your strong card is procedural: you requested a written explanation two weeks ago and got silence. Most civil service frameworks require timely, documented feedback. Chase it formally, in writing, citing the relevant recruitment policy and deadline.

If the eventual reasoning is vague, inconsistent, or applies criteria not in the job specification, that is actionable. Build on documents, not on who sat in the room.
